plugins.name: vital-focused
plugins.description: FOCUSED coaching (Frame, Options, Criteria, Unknowns, Score, Examine, Decide). Runs offline with a local session file and pack tools for worksheets, score with ±10 robustness, and brief. Person decides at every step; skills never name a winner. Optional vdec_ key enables Decision cloud sync or usage only. Optional vont_ / vvfy_ for Navigator sealed scores and Verify claim checks. Human oversight required. Product of Crossroads Catalyst GmbH (Vital Expert).
